meta.title: Hemingway — compositional demo
meta.thesis: Same facts. Neutral has no knowledge base. +Voice adds who Venmo is (held constant). +Tone adds how Venmo flexes (by audience, or by how the writer signals the moment).
meta.reading: The +voice column is IDENTICAL across variants — that is voice held. The +tone columns DIVERGE — that is tone flexed. The hero is a controlled ablation (knowledge base in the room vs. out of it), not a live competitor.

events.label: Card locked
events.facts: A parent locked the teen's Venmo debit card. It can't be used for purchases until it's unlocked. The teen can still send and receive money in the app.
events.neutral: This debit card has been locked and cannot be used for purchases until it is unlocked. Sending and receiving payments remains available.
events.voice: Your debit card is locked, so it can't be used for purchases right now. You can still send and receive money in the app.

variants.label: → teen
variants.copy: Judy locked your debit card. Card transactions will be declined until Judy unlocks it — you can still send and receive money in the app.
tells: names the guardian as the actor — no blame

variants.label: → parent
variants.copy: You locked [teen]'s debit card. In the meantime, they can still send and receive payments in the Venmo app.
tells: about the teen, not to them

events.flex_note: Voice is identical. Tone is calm for both — but the FRAME mirrors: the teen is told a guardian acted on them; the parent is told they acted. Same fact, opposite point of view.

events.label: Card unlocked
events.facts: A parent unlocked the teen's debit card. It can be used for purchases again.
events.neutral: This debit card has been unlocked and can be used for purchases again.
events.voice: Your debit card is unlocked, so you can use it for purchases again.

variants.label: → teen
variants.copy: Judy unlocked your debit card. You can use your debit card again. 🤘🙌🖖
tells: emoji closer — the compact tone tell

variants.label: → parent
variants.copy: You unlocked [teen]'s debit card. They can make card purchases again.

events.flex_note: ★ The split. +Voice is one line, shared by both. +Tone diverges: the teen earns the emoji and the lift (playful); the parent gets the same news, calm and dry. Voice held, tone flexed.

events.label: Account restricted (security flag)
events.facts: The account was restricted after activity was flagged. The app and debit card can't be used. Resolving it means contacting Venmo — a teen routes through a parent/guardian; a parent calls.
events.neutral: This account has been restricted due to flagged activity. The Venmo app and debit card cannot be used until the restriction is resolved.
events.voice: Your access to the Venmo app and debit card is restricted right now. We flag activity like this to keep Venmo safe — here's how to get it sorted.

variants.label: → teen
variants.copy: Your access to the Venmo app and debit card have been restricted. For help getting up and running again, ask your parent or guardian to contact us.
tells: calm on an alarming event — reassure, don't alarm
routes the teen up to a guardian

variants.label: → parent
variants.copy: Activity on [teen]'s account triggered an alert, so this account and any linked accounts are restricted. For help unlocking your accounts, give us a call.

events.flex_note: The stress test: the VOICE holds even when the event is scary. Tone stays calm for both (reassure-don't-alarm) — what flexes is the ROUTE: teen → ask your guardian; parent → call us.

events.label: Account restricted (age) — the reframe
events.facts: The teen signed up for an adult account but doesn't meet the age requirements, so it's restricted. To continue they close it and set up a teen account from their parent's invite. (The account is inactive during the downgrade — so this is really an onboarding fail-state.)
events.neutral: This account does not meet the age requirements and has been restricted. To continue, close it and set up a new account.
events.voice: Your account doesn't meet the age requirements, so it's been restricted. Close it and you can set up the right one.

variants.label: signaled as needs_action
variants.copy: Your account has been restricted because you don't meet the age requirements. Close this account to continue — you'll need to set up a new one.
tells: framed as a cold compliance restriction

variants.label: signaled as onboarding ★
variants.copy: Your old account has been restricted, but you have a new one waiting. Close it to get started — then use the invite your parent or guardian sent. Why the restriction? You don't meet the age requirements for your existing account.
tells: reframed with a path forward — not a dead end
acknowledges the bad moment without fake cheer
stays calm and plain — the system knows NOT to be playful here

events.flex_note: The restraint beat: same bad news. Cold as a needs_action compliance restriction; steady with a path forward as an onboarding — but never playful. The intelligence is knowing the ceiling: a kid aged out is a genuinely bad experience, so warmth here means a clear way forward, not delight.
